Helping the next generation explore STEM.

Our team shares robotics with local students through elementary school science nights and middle school events.

Science nights and school visits

Elementary school science night

We visit local elementary schools to present simple robotics demos, teach students about engineering, and spark curiosity about STEM.

Middle school STEM events

Our team shares more in-depth robotics demonstrations with middle school students and encourages them to explore coding, design, and teamwork.

We believe STEM careers are the future, and that education regarding this field is essential. For this reason we make it a priority to get more people interested and involved in STEM as much as possible. Robotics is a great way to accomplish this. We do our best to publicize our team within our school, as well as in our community and feeder schools, such as Indian Hills Middle School and Westwood View Elementary. These places allow us to show our work to younger kids and inspire passion in them for what we love.
